title: Trove contact
description: One line of contacts/<source>/<account>.jsonl. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash; may be "" in sparse lines, the folder then names it)

id.description: source-native stable contact id, the dedupe key (Google resourceName, CNContact.identifier, vCard UID, a CRM row id, or a name+email composite where the export carries none)

account.description: the connected account this contact belongs to (Google account address; absent for single-store imports)

name.description: display name, from the primary name entry

emails.description: email handles, lowercased, in source order, dupes removed

phones.description: phone handles, E.164 where derivable, else verbatim

name.description: organization / company name (LinkedIn Company, vCard ORG)

title.description: job title / position at the organization (LinkedIn Position, vCard TITLE)

orgs.description: organizations / job titles: {name?, title?} (LinkedIn Company/Position, vCard ORG/TITLE)

photo.description: profile photo URL (real photos only; base64 blobs are stripped, never inlined)

other.description: auto-collected rather than user-saved (Google's "Other contacts" — everyone you've corresponded with)

updated.description: RFC3339 local time the contact last changed at the source, if known

extra.description: everything source-specific — birthdays, addresses, URLs, notes, relationship context (connected_on, last_talked_to), CRM tags/enrichment — full fidelity
